item.title: Renormalisation Group II: Loops, Infinities and Cutoffs
item.description: Part 2 of the renormalisation group course. The toolkit from zero, with a picture for each idea: where loop integrals come from, the Wick rotation done as a real contour integral, why loops blow up, what a cutoff is, three ways to regularise the same integral and what renormalisation actually does. With an interactive cutoff widget.
